title: Login with valid credentials
steps: Open the login page; enter username; enter password; click Login

title: Authenticate with correct details
steps: Navigate to authentication screen; type username and password; press the login button

title: Sign in successfully
steps: Go to login page; input username; input password; select Sign in

title: Login with invalid password
steps: Open login page; enter username; enter invalid password; click Login

title: Reject incorrect credentials
steps: Navigate to login page; type wrong password; click login button

title: Password reset request
steps: Click Forgot password; enter registered email; click Send

title: Request a password recovery link
preconditions: User is on the sign-in page
steps: Select Forgot password; type email address; press Send

title: Add item to shopping cart
steps: Open product page; click Add to cart

title: Put a product in the basket
steps: Navigate to product page; press Add to basket
expected_result: Selected product is shown in cart

title: Remove item from cart
expected_result: Cart no longer contains the product

title: Delete a basket item
steps: Go to basket; select Remove item

title: Search for a product
steps: Enter headphones in search field; click Search

title: Find products by keyword
steps: Type headphones into the search box; press Search

title: Update account email
steps: Open profile; enter new email; click Save

title: Change the profile email address
steps: Navigate to profile settings; type a new email address; press Save

title: Display past purchases
steps: Go to account page; select Orders
expected_result: A list of previous orders is shown
